items.title: Terminate Current Pane Process
items.description: confirm, then send SIGTERM to current pane child

action.tmux: confirm-before -p 'SIGTERM process in current pane? (y/n)' "run-shell '~/.config/tmux/plugins/tmux-cowboy/scripts/kill.sh TERM'"

items.title: Kill Current Pane Process
items.description: confirm, then send SIGKILL to current pane child

action.tmux: confirm-before -p 'SIGKILL process in current pane? (y/n)' "run-shell '~/.config/tmux/plugins/tmux-cowboy/scripts/kill.sh KILL'"
